subject: TEST RESULT: ordered timestamped batch preserves tested hinge semantics; min/max/final does not
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-hinge-ingress-edge-preservation-20261002. Reduced source-faithful Python model executed locally against thresholds/rules reconstructed from current main. Deterministic 6/6 PASS, including slow-close intent loss, three active-closing reversal/reclose identities, deeper-floor reversal, and fail-closed overflow. Exhaustive discrete grid: 33,300 bursts; full delivery invalidated original cycle in 30,655; current latest-only missed 13,239 of those. A min/max/final compression prototype was REJECTED: 85 missed invalidations. Proposed bounded ordered source-time batch (capacity 16; no overflow in this grid) had 0 missed invalidations and 0 signature mismatches versus full delivery. Fixed-seed 100,000 random bursts length 2..12: full invalidated original cycle in 67,618; current latest-only missed 28,077; min/max/final missed 2,074; ordered batch had 0 misses and 0 signature mismatches. Separate fixed-seed 100,000 long-burst run length 2..40 with capacity16 and conservative discontinuity on overflow: 61,517 overflows; 0 cases retained the original cycle when full delivery invalidated it; 11,091 conservative extra invalidations (tradeoff requiring device-rate/main-stall calibration). Counts are MODEL behavior, not real-world probabilities. Fold7 device validation remains required.

artifacts.purpose: reduced current-ingress/controller/cycle model plus proposed bounded ordered batch
